notes.title: [THE HANGED MAN] Chinese language support update and the commemorative sale!
notes.notes:
To all of our fans,

Thank you for playing THE SAND MAN.

We are pleased to announce that we have added Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese to the supported languages for The Hanged Man, the final chapter of “The Strange Man” series.

To celebrate, all four titles in “The Strange Man” series, The Crooked Man, The Sand Man, The Boogie Man, and The Hanged Man will be on sale for 50% off for one week from March 15th, 2:00 AM to March 22nd, 2:00 AM (JST).
This is the perfect chance to enjoy the series if you haven’t already so grab your copies today!

notes.title: Update: Chinese and Korean Support Added, Large-Scale System Update Implemented
notes.notes:
Dear Fans,

Thank you for playing THE SAND MAN.

This message is to inform you that a new update has gone live.
The following changes have been made in this patch.


Simplified Chinese support has been added.
Korean support has been added.
Parts of the UI have been updated.
Save data can now be carried over, regardless of original language settings.
Game stability has been improved.
Multiple minor bugs have been fixed.


Again, thank you for your continued support.
